question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, permission, retention, and command-data boundary must those widgets follow?
rationale: The feature is plausible and fits the dashboard roadmap, but it exposes operational logs and command output in a new persistent UI surface and depends on unresolved dashboard binding/security choices.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate first, and implement the widgets only after maintainers approve the log/output disclosure and binding contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Allow a focused follow-up only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command output, excluding new command execution or generic stream bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers decide whether these should be bundled dashboard widgets or external plugin work.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate first, and implement the widgets only after maintainers approve the log/output disclosure and binding contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the Control UI plugin-tab/log-tail/terminal boundary that this feature would extend.
